svg.title: Your local kind cluster today
svg.desc: Docker Desktop runs one container, demo-control-plane, which is the Kubernetes node. Inside it run the control plane, ingress-nginx, and namespace demo with orders-frontend, orders-web, orders-worker and orders-beat Deployments, postgres-0 and redis-0 StatefulSets with 1Gi PVCs, a Secret and Helm release history.
svg.text: one Docker container; pods run inside it
no Service: they pull jobs from Redis

g.text: kept so you can roll back
